# seerr_user_import_plex (Data Source)

Read users imported from a connected Plex server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read existing Plex users imported into Seerr
data "seerr_user_import_plex" "all" {}

output "imported_plex_users" {
  value = data.seerr_user_import_plex.all.imported_users
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `imported_count` (Number) Number of Plex users imported.
- `imported_users` (Attributes List) List of users imported from Plex. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--imported_users))

<a id="nestedatt--imported_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `imported_users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) The numeric Seerr user ID.
- `plex_id` (String) The user's Plex ID.
- `username` (String) The user's display name.
